baslik: What Lightning Really Does to a Building
aciklama:
Lightning is five times hotter than the sun and can blow concrete apart. Here is how it destroys.

#shorts #science #lightning #nature #howitworks

sahneler.metin: A single lightning bolt is five times hotter than the sun.
It carries a billion volts in a fraction of a second.
When it hits a building, it looks for the fastest path down.
If that path runs through water or wiring, it boils them instantly.
Trapped moisture turns to steam and blows brick and concrete apart.
That is why a struck tree can explode from the inside.
Lightning rods give it a safe metal path straight to the ground.
Without one, the bolt writes its own path - through anything.
Nature packs a power plant into a single flash.

vaka.yanilgi: Lightning rods don't attract lightning — they give a strike that's already coming a safe path to the ground.
